lines.text: Good luck out there Forty. I’ll be rooting for you.
MonRoll and I went undercover at a bakery. I guess we were a little too convincing. There was a lunch rush. Two for one flash pastry sale.

He’s in rough shape Forty, but he’ll be fine. Thanks to Q’s brilliant engineering, MonRoll wore a special Caramel Pecan disguise which kept him completely inedible except to some seagulls we encountered just prior to extraction.
Caramel Pecan?! That’s… disgusting. Glad you two made it out. Speedy recovery.
